_doc: The playbook agent (playbooks/agent.py): it writes a draft for each step of an open intervention and nothing else. Every number it uses lives here. Env PLAYBOOK_AGENT_MODEL overrides llm.model at runtime. The agent has no approve, send, report or level-change path: those stay in playbooks/governance.py and refuse an actor of kind 'agent'.

limits._doc: daily_drafts_per_tenant counts every draft written today (UTC) for the tenant, model or not; it is the agent's own cap, on top of the tenant's model budget (utils/llm_budget_controller). draft_chars cuts a step draft; quote_chars cuts each evidence quote shown to the model; max_evidence caps how many evidence items are shown.

labels.stub: No model: drafted from the trigger facts by fixed rules
